description: Overall and per-node health of the upstream XRPL nodes. When to use: To decide whether to trust or retry data, or to explain a 503 from another endpoint. Prefer another tool: Not a probe of your own connectivity; it reports the service's upstream nodes. Example: xrpl_network_health {}
name: xrpl_network_health

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open; null when no read behind the answer names a ledger, never 0

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

median_latency_ms.description: The median latency_ms of the up nodes' latest samples (the mean of the two middle values for an even count); null when no node is up

amendment_blocked.description: The node's server_info amendment_blocked at the last probe: true when the node has stopped following the network until it is upgraded; false when server_info omits it (rippled writes it only when blocked). Null when the node did not answer or the value was not stored yet.

complete_ledgers.description: The node's server_info complete_ledgers at the last probe, parsed into ranges in rippled's order, both bounds included (a single ledger has equal bounds): which ledgers the node can answer, for transactions paging and past-ledger reads. [] when the node holds none (rippled's empty). Null when the node did not answer, the value was not stored yet, or it does not parse as rippled's format.

anyOf.description: The node's last probe error as a code matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$, such as timeout or http_503; any other upstream error text is reported as upstream_error. Null when the last probe succeeded.

ledger_age_seconds.description: Age of the node's latest validated ledger at the last probe, in seconds: server_info's validated_ledger.age. rippled reports 0 once the age reaches 1,000,000 s, so 0 alone does not prove a fresh ledger. Null when the node was down at the last probe or reported no age

load_factor_multiplier.description: The node's server load factor without open-ledger fee escalation, decimal string: server_info's load_factor_server (its load_factor when the node omits it) at the last probe; 1 means no load. Null when the last probe reported none.

server_state.description: The node's server_info server_state at the last probe: whether it follows the network now. full has the ledger and agrees with the network; tracking, syncing, connected and disconnected lag or are not in sync. Null when the node did not answer, the value was not stored yet, or it is outside these five.

title: Network health
